lm.caption: An energetic and driving synthwave instrumental loop. The track is built on a foundation of a punchy, gated-reverb drum machine beat and a pulsing synth bassline. Bright, brassy synthesizer chords provide the harmonic structure, while a catchy, melodic synth lead carries the main theme. The production is clean and polished with a distinct retro-futuristic feel, characteristic of 80s electronic music.
